practices.name: Irvine Smile Dentistry
practices.summary: Irvine Smile Dentistry lists Medi-Cal Dental among its payment options. Its website welcomes new patients and families, but that general invitation does not establish new Medi-Cal patient openings. Ask the office about the care you need and available appointments.
suggested_patient_questions: Are you booking new Medi-Cal Dental patients at your Irvine Center Drive office?
Can the dentist I would see provide my requested care through Medi-Cal Dental?
Is authorization needed, and can you explain any expected costs before treatment?
Can you arrange interpretation in the language or communication format I need?
Can you describe step-free access, accessible parking, restroom access and getting to the dental chair?

practices.name: QH Dental
practices.summary: QH Dental lists Denti-Cal among its insurance options. Its published notice describes free language interpretation, sign-language interpreters and written information in accessible formats. Confirm new Medi-Cal patient openings and how to request assistance; the notice leaves the service-request contact blank.
suggested_patient_questions: Are you booking new Medi-Cal Dental patients at your Quail Hill office?
Can my requested care be provided through Medi-Cal Dental, and is authorization needed?
How do I request the interpreter or accessible format described in your notice?
Can you describe step-free access, accessible parking, restroom access and getting to the dental chair?

shared_patient_questions: What is the next available appointment for my type of care?
If you cannot meet my access needs or see me, can you help identify an appropriate referral?
Can I discuss comfort needs such as quieter visits, breaks or communication preferences before booking?
